Mar 2026 • Friends
If you’re planning a farewell meal or a special memory with your close friends, I honestly wouldn’t recommend this place.

The restaurant looks nice and spacious, so we expected a good experience. Unfortunately, the service was very disappointing. Our table had 8 people and we ordered 4 plates of meat, but we waited more than 1.5 hours. We had to remind the staff many times, and the food came out very slowly, one small plate at a time. By the time we were still waiting for the last plate, the staff told us the restaurant was about to close.

For a meal that cost over 3 million VND, the experience was really not worth it. A farewell meal should be something memorable for good reasons, not because of poor service and long waiting times.

A Culinary Journey to the Heart of Thailand at Bêp Thai Koh Yam
Oct 2023 • Family
Tonight, I had the honor of dining at Restaurant Bêp Thai Koh Yam, and I can say without a shred of exaggeration that it was a culinary experience that surpassed all expectations. The food here is not only authentic and delicious, it even transcends the flavors I have experienced in the many Thai restaurants I visited during my travels through Thailand.

Our meal commenced with a serving of fried mushrooms that were perfectly crispy and delightfully seasoned. The Pad Thai with shrimp was a heavenly tangle of flavors and textures, the best I’ve ever tasted. The glass noodles with vegetables were light and refreshing, while the famed papaya salad brought an explosion of spicy and tangy flavors that had our taste buds dancing with joy. The rice served in a pineapple was a creative and flavorful touch, and the Tom Yam Kung was the perfect balance of spicy and aromatic.

Not only was the food impeccable, but the service was also exemplary. We were fortunate to be served by Pham Tuan Minh, whose attentiveness, professionalism, and warmth made our evening out extra special. His recommendations were spot-on, and his care for our well-being was genuine.

Each dish at Bêp Thai Koh Yam tells a story of the rich Thai culinary tradition, with a touch of modernity that’s unique to this remarkable restaurant. If you are seeking an unforgettable Thai dining experience, Bêp Thai Koh Yam is the place to be. It’s not merely a meal, but a journey for your senses to the heart of Thailand. I am already looking forward to returning and exploring more of their delightful menu.

Craving for authentic Thai lunch
Nov 2022 • Couples
We were searching for a great Thai food experience and looking through TA, we dicided to go here.
Upon arrival we were told to order fast, as the kitchen was closing soon.
We were seated and our orders came fast, then we got mentioned the kitchen had run out of steam rice, we replaced it to bun.

Tom yum soup seafood (small), consisted out of some fish cakes, squid and 1 tiger prawn. Flavor was lacking, no hints of the spicy or the lemongrass that you normall find. A big miss unfortunately

Pad Thai, was rich filled with chicken and tofu, unfortunately lacking of the flavors and taste, very blend.

Deep fry crispy catfish with green mango salad. This dish was quite tasty and big portioned.

The mango and sticky rice as dessert, mango was ripe and tasty. 

Associates were not very friendly or helpfull. Also attentative was not there, we had to look amd ask for serving staff many times in order to get our order completed,served or table to be cleared.

All by all, location was nice vallue for money and the experience on its own very poor.

I hope they can look into the flavor profile of the dishes and services and make improvement moving forward.
